limitations: No recursive history or raw worker data is copied.
Owner fields, inline links and single-line reference definitions are inventoried. Other literal code paths remain source text.
Heading fragments are retained; support depends on the reader. Search headings or open the listed file path if needed.
Exact originals in sources/ retain original links. Use documents/ for rebased portable links.
Formulas retain original TeX. The bundle does not rewrite explanations or prove scientific correctness.
Absolute execution paths inside exact originals and JSON identities are provenance, not remotely accessible read links. Use documents/ for the portable report.

Five exact selected images are in System sync/1012_a17_mechanism_evidence and referenced relatively; original tensors, raw native predictions and logs remain execution-side. Private repository access still requires the reader to have repository permission.
